question: In 1905, Hindus and Muslims tied 'Rakhi' on each other's hands to show their unity and their protest against the ________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Partition of Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **1905**, the British government, under the leadership of **Lord Curzon**, implemented the **Partition of Bengal**, dividing the province into two parts: **East Bengal and Assam** (predominantly Muslim) and **West Bengal** (predominantly Hindu).
